response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and polyglot development skills with a focus on open-source contributions and mentorship, but lacks the required depth in C++ and large-scale cloud compute infrastructure specified in the job description. His leadership experience is more informal (workshops, talks) rather than formal technical leadership in cloud/DevOps contexts.
strengths: Extensive experience in software craftsmanship, including TDD, CI/CD, and mentoring through workshops and talks.
Diverse technical background spanning web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems with open-source contributions (e.g., GISCollective).
Strong problem-solving skills and adaptability, evidenced by contributions to AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling at re:cinq.
concerns: Insufficient C++ experience (only ~1 year at National Instruments) compared to the 8-year requirement.
Limited direct experience with large-scale cloud compute platforms or distributed systems at the production level.
Technical leadership is primarily informal (workshops, talks) rather than formal (e.g., leading cloud/DevOps teams).
